messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated p95 latency detected in eu-west region for hosted inference (service: inference-api, model tag: redwood-base-2q8). p95 > 2.5s, throughput down ~35% over 6m. Paging @dmitri_oncall.

dmitri_oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Starting triage — pulling recent autoscale events and node health. Will post quick triage in 2m.

alice_sre: Noting KV cache eviction spikes on kvproxy-eu-*. Seeing increased cache misses ~18% which could explain extra decode cost.

ben_ml: Also seeing model server OOM/GC churn on a subset of pods (quantized binaries). Error sample: `OOMKilled` with logs showing `CUDA OOM` shortly before p95 spikes.

dmitri_oncall: Good signal correlation: cache churn -> more full-forward passes -> higher memory pressure. First mitigation: enable temporary prefix caching bypass and route new requests to dedicated-capacity pool in eu-west: `route policy set eu-west -> dedicated-pool-2` (will run if autoscale won't handle).

sre-bot: Runbook action triggered: `incident/latency-eu/start-mitigation v1` (owner: dmitri_oncall). Checklist: 1) route change, 2) scale dedicated pool + add 2x nodes, 3) enable model fallback to -small if error rate increases.

dmitri_oncall: Executed route change (commit id `c3f9bac`). Kicking scale: `infra scale dedicated-pool-2 --add 2`. Watching metrics.

carla_pm: Customer impact flags: some high-volume customers in EU may see degraded tail latency or rate-limited responses. Is there a short customer-facing blurb we can post to status page?

evan_support: We need a concise template we can paste into Intercom/Support to triage incoming tickets.

dmitri_oncall: Draft status page update (paste-ready):

```
Incident: Elevated latency and reduced throughput in EU region (investigating)
Status: Investigating
Started: 2026-03-17 09:40 UTC
Impact: Customers using hosted inference in eu-west may experience increased p95 latency and occasional request failures. Throughput reduced for some model variants.
Mitigation: We have routed traffic to dedicated capacity in the region, initiated autoscale, and are enabling a fallback model variant for high-error flows. No data loss expected.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have a mitigation result.
```

carla_pm: That looks good — keep wording clear about ETA for recovery. Add a line: "If you rely on strict latency SLAs, please reach out to support for a temporary reserved capacity option."

ben_ml: On the model side, I'll stage a safe fallback to `redwood-base-2q8-small` for non-sensitive routes. Fallback healthchecks enabled: if error_rate > 1% we'll auto-revert.

dmitri_oncall: Scale completed, route change in effect. Early metrics: p95 down from 2.7s -> 1.6s on routed traffic; overall cluster p95 still ~2.0s as nodes warm. Throughput recovery trending up.

sre-bot: Note: KV eviction alert suppressed (temporary) to avoid noise. Remember to re-enable post-incident.

evan_support: Customer notification template (support copy):

"Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating elevated API latency in our eu-west region affecting some hosted inference requests. We have routed traffic to additional capacity and applied mitigations; you may see improved latency in the next 20–40 minutes. If your application requires an immediate SLA-backed alternative, let us know and we can discuss reserved capacity or region-specific routing. Apologies for the disruption — we'll follow up with a resolution update shortly.
Best, Redwood Support"

carla_pm: Internal comms short (for ops+sales): "Investigating EU latency. Routing to dedicated capacity and enabling model fallback. Expected partial recovery within 20–40m. Contact support for high-importance customers."

ben_ml: Note for postmortem: gather KV miss rate, pod OOM events, model version distribution, and autoscale latency. Assigning myself and dmitri to that follow-up.

dmitri_oncall: Passing to night-shift: @alice_sre will monitor next 4h and own the handoff doc. Action item for next: re-run `kvproxy` memory tuning, validate quantized binary memory footprint, and schedule a canary for fallback model tomorrow morning.

alice_sre: I have the handoff checklist. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/eu-inference. Will post any regressions and escalate.

dmitri_oncall: Thanks — marking incident as "Mitigating". I'll update status page with the drafted blurb and close the page when metrics stabilize.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Status -> Mitigating. Next automated check in 15m.
